messages:
Jordan: heads up — after the docusaurus deploy a few pages have broken image anchors and the TOC links jump to top instead of section 
Elena: ugh, saw that on staging earlier, thought it was local caching :grimacing:  which pages?
Jordan: examples/embeddings.md and guides/migration/private-deploy.md — images that used explicit fragment anchors like `#img-kv-cache` no longer resolve. also some h3->slug changes so links like /docs#kv-cache fail
Chris: looks like the slugifier changed during the mkdocs->docusaurus migration. `-` vs `_` and unicode normalization differ. can we normalize slugs at build time?
Marco: quick test: in the embeddings page the heading is `### KV Cache (prefix)` which generates `kv-cache-prefix` before, now it's `kv_cache_prefix` on prod.  I ran `npx docusaurus-helpers slugify 'KV Cache (prefix)'` and got the underscore variant.
Jordan: rough idea: we should add a redirect map for the common old fragment patterns so older inbound links keep working. short-term patch in the site config. long term: regenerate anchors or standardize headings.
Elena: i'll open a small PR with a redirects entry and a note in the migration guide. can someone add the failing URLs (from GA)?
Chris: here are a few from the logs: `/docs/embeddings#kv-cache`, `/docs/embeddings#img-kv-cache`, `/docs/private-deploy#network-ips` — also an old external link from partner docs to `/docs#migrating-from-old-api`
Jordan: thanks. @DocsBot can you create a redirect rule placeholder for those three?
DocsBot: created redirect ticket RW-1268 with priority P2 — https://board.internal/issue/RW-1268
Marco: PR suggestion: rather than hardcoding every fragment, add a canonical slug mapping script that runs post-build and emits redirect HTML pages for legacy fragments. That avoids huge redirect lists.
Elena: agree. For immediate fix i'll add a couple of redirects in `docusaurus.config.js` under `clientSideRedirects` so the high-traffic ones land correctly. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Chris: quick nit — the embeddings example code block had an extra leading space in the fenced block which caused the anchor to be attached to the code block instead of the heading. e.g.
```
 \```js
 const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
 client.embed('text')
 \```
```
Jordan: oh yeah, that explains why `#usage` was missing from generated slugs. small formatting errors create big anchor mismatches.
Elena: patching the snippet in the PR. also adding a CI linkcheck job to fail on broken fragments for docs/ changes.
Marco: FYI tests — run `yarn docs:check-links` locally (uses linkinator). if you want stricter, add `--fragments` to validate anchors.
Chris: can we also add a lint rule to flag headings with parentheses / special chars that generate weird slugs?
Jordan: good idea. maybe a markdownlint rule or a custom rule in the docs-build pipeline. file an RFC?
Elena: opened RW-1270 for slug lint + post-build redirect script. putting it in the docs backlog.
Jordan: summary actions: Elena -> merge redirect PR for high-traffic fragments; Marco -> prototype post-build redirect generator; Chris -> add link check with fragments in CI; DocsBot -> keep RW-1268 updated.
Chris: i'll add the CI job in a follow-up PR after the redirect PR merges.
Elena: merging now, deploying to staging. will ping when staging is green :rocket:
DocsBot: deploy started for branch patch/embeddings-redirects — build #5622
Jordan: thanks all, once staging confirms i'll open a release note and update the migration guide with the slug normalization note
Marco: one last thing — partner docs that link to old fragments: can we add a short TTL proxy so partner links get rewritten server-side? less churn for partners.
Jordan: let's discuss in product sync, adding to RW-1271. for now redirects + CI should stop regressions.
Elena: staging ✅ — fragments resolve for the three high-traffic links. merging to main
Jordan: great. closing the thread once RW-1268 shows prod deploy success. :thumbsup:
